what: The site bar on every page of this site (blackbox_agent viewer CONTRACT §18, drawn by the package's bb-site-nav): the box's name (to the landing page) and its dashboards in the top row, the open dashboard's own tabs below (the stock tabs, then this box's own from site/tabs/: the Scoreboard). Hand-written; every href is relative to this file and inside the site, so robot-sdk's live directory (https://zacharyyamaoka.github.io/robot_sdk/) is linked from the Scoreboard tab, not from here. A dashboard joins by adding one entry here and its id in order.

dashboards.label: Black box
dashboards.about: The agent's search: the solutions, the gates, the agents, the activity and the ideas; the Scoreboard tab holds every solution's gate matrix against robot-sdk's live directory.
